title: Reference Types
description: Learn about C# reference types including classes, arrays, and strings.

data.text: **Reference types** store a reference (pointer) to the data. They're stored on the heap and shared when assigned.

data.title: Strings
Arrays
Reference Semantics
data.text: When you assign a reference type, both variables point to the same object. Changes affect both.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Classes, strings, arrays are reference types
data.takeaway: Reference types store references to data.
